title: 【公式】出島〜dejima〜

facts.fact: Dejima was completed in1636; the Dutch trading post moved from Hirado in1641. The modern restoration concentrates on its early19th-century appearance.
facts.excerpt: The current restoration project focuses on Dejima as it looked around 1820
facts.location: History > Period of Trade with the Dutch

facts.fact: The island disappeared as surrounding land was reclaimed; visitors see restored buildings and remains from several historical periods, not an entirely untouched island.
facts.excerpt: Land reclamations from the harbor resulted in the loss of Dejima as an island
facts.location: History > Period of Trade with Portugal

facts.fact: Restoration of16buildings including the chief factor quarters has been completed; the venue also preserves Meiji-era buildings.
facts.excerpt: The restoration of 16 buildings, including the Chief Factor's Quarters, has already been completed.

facts.fact: Normal venue admission does not allow reentry, and some facilities may be unavailable for maintenance.
facts.excerpt: Please be reminded that re-entry is not possible
